auth.socialFailed: That sign-in didn't work. Try again.
auth.contactWhy: We use it to keep your account secure. It stays private and never shows on your profile.
auth.phoneNote: We'll text you a 6-digit code to confirm it's you.
auth.emailNote: We'll email you a 6-digit code to confirm it's you.
auth.codeFailed: We couldn't send a code. Check it and try again.
auth.typeCode: Type the 6-digit code we just sent you.
auth.noCodeYet: No code yet? It can take a minute.
auth.codeWrong: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
auth.nameWhy: Add your name so friends can find you.
auth.passwordRule: Use 8 or more characters. Mix letters and numbers.
auth.passwordFailed: We couldn't save that password. Try another.
auth.birthdayPrivate: Your birthday is never shown on your profile.
auth.tooYoung: You need to be at least 13 to sign up.
auth.ageWhy: We ask so the app stays age-appropriate. You must be 13 or older to join.
auth.usernameTaken: That username was just taken. Go back and pick another.
auth.loginFailed: That login didn't work. Check your details and try again.

username.title: Choose your username
username.why: This is how friends find you and see your proof. You can change it later in Settings.
username.label: Username
username.rule: Letters, numbers, periods and underscores. 3 to 30 characters.
username.chars: Usernames can only use letters, numbers, periods and underscores.
username.short: Too short. Use at least 3 characters.
username.long: Too long. Use 30 characters or fewer.
username.dots: Usernames can't start or end with a period.

terms.title: Before you start
terms.intro: Tap I agree to accept {{app}}'s Community Guidelines, Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
terms.canPostBody: Proof of real work and sincere motivation in five topics: fitness, learning, work and tech, money and health, and motivation. Think running, reading, coding, working with AI, trading, cooking or a quote that keeps you going.
terms.neverBody: Nudity or sexual content, anything illegal, violence or self-harm, hate or bullying, scams or fake proof, and alcohol, vaping or gambling.
terms.strikes: Every post and scroll is checked before it goes up. Stories aren't checked first, but the same rules apply and anyone can report them. Breaking the rules gives a strike, and 3 strikes pauses posting for 7 days. Sexual content involving minors removes the account and is reported.

done.title: Welcome to {{app}}
done.body: Your account is ready. Post your first proof today to start your streak.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Tell us your username, email or phone and we'll send you a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If an account matches what you entered, we sent a reset link to it.

home.emptyFeed: Your feed is quiet. Support people from Search, or post your own proof.

certificate.title: Certificate of Achievement
certificate.checked: Checked by AI from their video. AI can make mistakes.
certificate.congrats: You did it. Your goal is finished.

comments.title: Comments
comments.empty: No comments yet. Start the conversation.
comments.offensive: Remove the offensive word to post this comment.
comments.notAllowed: You can't comment on this post.

share.title: Share
share.noFriends: Support someone to send them posts.

create.title: Create
create.postSub: Photo or video to your feed
create.storySub: Photo or video with text, shows for 24 hours
create.scrollSub: Short vertical video for the Scrolls feed

suspended.title: Posting is suspended for 7 days
suspended.body: Your account has 3 strikes for posts that broke the guidelines. You can still watch, like and message. If you think a strike was a mistake, request a review from Account status.

commit.goalSub: Say it out loud. Big or small, it counts. It goes on your profile. You get 24 hours to fix it, then it locks until a video proves you did it.
commit.excuseTitle: Be honest. What's your go-to excuse?
commit.excuse_mondayReply: Monday has been very busy for years now.
commit.excuse_tiredReply: Everyone's tired. Some of them post anyway.
commit.excuse_timeReply: You had time to download this app.
commit.badDayTitle: You did everything right. It still went badly. Now what?
commit.badDay_againReply: That's the whole app, right there.
commit.badDay_learn: Find out what went wrong and fix it
commit.badDay_learnReply: Good. Bad results are just information.
commit.badDay_restReply: Rest is part of the work. Quitting isn't.
commit.badDay_quitReply: Everyone does. Showing up anyway is the whole point.
commit.goalVague: Pick something a video could prove, like "Run a marathon" or "Read 50 books".
commit.goalHarm: Pick a goal that builds you up, not one that hurts someone else.
commit.careBody: You don't have to carry this alone, and it isn't something to push through with a streak. Please talk to a parent, a teacher or another adult you trust today.
commit.careHelp: If you might be in danger right now, call your local emergency number. You can also reach {{line}}.
commit.hardestTitle: What's the hardest part for you?
commit.hardest_startingReply: Starting takes one post. You can do one post.
commit.hardest_stayingReply: That's exactly what a streak is for.
commit.hardest_believingReply: You don't have to believe it today. Just show up.
commit.compareTitle: Someone started after you and is already ahead. What do you do?
commit.compare_askReply: Smart. Then get back to work.
commit.compare_bothered: It would bother me, but I'd keep going
commit.compare_botheredReply: It bothers everyone. Keep going anyway.
commit.nobodyTitle: No likes. No comments. Nobody watching. Do you still do the work?
commit.nobodySub: Some days that's exactly how it will feel.
commit.nobody_yesReply: Then you're already ahead of most people.
commit.nobody_someReply: Honest. This app is for those days.
commit.nobody_seen: I need people to see it
commit.nobody_seenReply: Fair. That's why you post it here.
commit.dareTitle: One post. Every single day. Deal?
commit.dareSub: Not results. Just proof you showed up for "{{goal}}".
commit.dare_dealReply: Good. Your future self just nodded.
commit.dare_miss: What if I miss a day?
commit.dare_missReply: Then you come back the next day. That's still the deal.
commit.level1: Did you even touch the screen?
commit.dareLow: A {{n}}? Sure you don't want to go higher?
commit.processResults: Results can let you down, even when your work was perfect. Keep working anyway.
commit.processMatters: That's why this app exists. Nobody here is judged by results. All that matters is that you worked hard, you never gave up, and you gave your 100%.

compose.caption: Caption
compose.offensive: Remove the offensive word to share this.
compose.needTopic: Pick a topic to share. Every post is checked to make sure it fits.
compose.demoBody: In the real app, AI looks at your video and decides from what it shows. Captions don't count. The demo can't do that, so pick what the AI would say.
compose.proofLimit: You can try to prove your goal 3 times a day. Try again tomorrow.
compose.notProvenTitle: Posted, but your goal isn't finished yet
compose.notProvenBody: The video has to clearly show the goal done. You can try again with another video.
compose.alsoScrollsSub: Makes this a video post that also plays in Scrolls.
compose.scanning: Scanning for content that isn't allowed
compose.offBody: Posts have to show real work or sincere motivation. Memes and random jokes aren't shared here. Change the topic, or post something that fits it. Trying again uses another of today's posts. This doesn't count as a strike.
compose.limitPosts: You can share {{n}} posts and scrolls a day, and posts that get blocked count too. Come back tomorrow.
compose.needTopicStory: Pick a topic for your story.
compose.banBody: Our check found content that isn't allowed here, like nudity, sexual content, violence or illegal activity. It wasn't shared.
compose.strikeLine: This is strike {{n}} of 3. At 3 strikes, posting is suspended for 7 days.
compose.strikeSuspended: This is strike {{n}} of 3. Posting is now suspended for 7 days.
compose.reviewBody: A person on our team will look at it within 24 hours. If the check got it wrong, your post goes up and any strike is removed.
compose.stillBody: This is taking longer than usual. Your post stays hidden until the check finishes, then goes up if it passes.
compose.failed: We couldn't share that. Check your connection and try again.

streak.start: Post today to start your streak.

settings.title: Settings
settings.showLists: Show my supporters and supporting lists
settings.showListsSub: Your numbers always show. If you hide your lists, you can still appear on other people's lists.
settings.privateSub: Only supporters you approve see your posts, scrolls, goal and streak
settings.noBlocked: You haven't blocked anyone. You can block someone from their profile.
settings.themeNote: Scrolls and stories stay dark in every theme.
settings.restartForLanguage: Restart the app to finish switching language.
settings.timeLimitNote: Get a reminder once you've used {{app}} this long in a day.
settings.limitReached: You've reached your daily time limit.
settings.dataSaverSub: Videos wait for a tap before playing
settings.statusNote: Strikes come from posts that break the guidelines. Each one expires after 90 days. Off-topic posts are removed but never give a strike.
settings.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your profile, posts, scrolls, stories, messages and streak. It can't be undone.
settings.remindMe: Remind me before my streak ends
settings.remindSub: Only sent on days you haven't posted yet
settings.freezeNote: You earn 1 freeze for every 7 days in a row. You can hold up to 2.
settings.autoFreezeSub: If you miss a day, a freeze saves your streak

guidelines.canPostNote: Every post and scroll needs one of these topics and has to actually show it. Stories aren't checked first, but the rules below still apply and anyone can report them.
guidelines.work: Coding, working with AI like Claude, design, building things
guidelines.sexualSub: Including suggestive or sexualized poses, outfits or captions
guidelines.illegalSub: Drugs, weapons, theft, or showing someone doing a crime
guidelines.violenceSub: Fights, injuries, or anything that encourages hurting yourself
guidelines.hateSub: Attacking anyone for who they are, or harassing people
guidelines.scamsSub: Guaranteed-profit trading, paid promos, or faked results
guidelines.offTopicSub: Includes memes and random jokes. Removed. No strike.
guidelines.breaksSub: 1 strike. 3 strikes in 90 days pauses posting for 7 days.
guidelines.zeroSub: Sexual content involving minors, or serious illegal content, removes the account right away and is reported to the authorities.
guidelines.reviewNote: Think a post was removed by mistake? Request a review and a person will check it within 24 hours.
